title: fix(account): allow 365-day earnings windows in CLI and MCP
author: ale-rls
pr_body_excerpt:
- Allows 1–365 earnings days through CLI and MCP, matching the backend; usage remains capped at 90.
- Updates earnings help and existing CLI docs; adds command/schema regressions with invalid-value and usage controls.
- Parent reran 16 CLI and 15 MCP account tests. Full local CLI suite: 291 pass; MCP: 22 pass. Build and Biome pass.
- Strict CLI typecheck has 36 identical baseline diagnostics; cached Vitest 2.1.9 is older than declared 3.x. MCP transport testing was unavailable.

Fixes #16385

gist.headline: A full year of pollen
gist.blurb: The earnings calendar finally stretches to 365 days in the CLI and MCP, matching the backend. Usage keeps its 90-day limit.
gist.summary: Fixed CLI and MCP earnings requests to accept 1–365 days, matching the backend, while keeping usage requests capped at 90 days.
gist.impact: Developers can request up to a year of earnings through the CLI or MCP instead of being stopped by a shorter client-side limit; usage remains capped at 90 days.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy terminal and MCP tool card sit beside a garden calendar spanning 365 days, with a separate 90-day marker for usage. Polli points out the longer earnings path while small code-plants grow around the screens.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, a terminal and MCP tool card display a little calendar marked '365 DAYS' beside a smaller 'USAGE 90' sign, with lime green (#ecf874) code-plants climbing their edges. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized, wears tiny reading glasses, and points warmly at the calendar—strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a warm cream background and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
